answer.reason: The verses tell of his evil reign and his killing by Shallum, which goes beyond the summary's bare statement of kingship.

clauses.english: was killed by Shallum, who conspired against him and reigned in his place
clauses.quote: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him

doubts: The verses spell the name Zachariah; the record is named Zechariah.
2KI 15:9 (did evil in the sight of the LORD) was left out as a judgment rather than a distinct event.
